target.summary: _sanitizeAttachedShadowRoots accesses nodeType, shadowRoot, and childNodes directly on root rather than through cached prototype getters. If root is or contains an HTMLFormElement, descendant elements can DOM-clobber these properties, causing the walk to skip shadow hosts and leave attached shadow roots unsanitized.
